Related signals/events also point to mounting issues: degraded condition, issue code MOUNTING_ISSUE, and repeated diagnostic alerts/recommendations to inspect sensor mounting [DOC-ASSET-029][EVT-00549]. This is general training knowledge, not OEM instructions.

Confidence is moderate.

VIBRATION_SENSOR#connector.text:
The connector is the top-exit signal-cable connector for the vibration sensor [KB-XRAY-VIBRATION_SENSOR#connector]. As general training knowledge, likely fault signs are a corroded or loose connector causing signal dropouts, reflected in reduced `signal_quality_pct` [KB-XRAY-VIBRATION_SENSOR#connector]. 

Evidence in this case supports degraded sensor quality and a mounting issue, not a connector-specific fault: health 58, condition “degraded,” issue code `MOUNTING_ISSUE`, and repeated alerts/work orders tied to mounting inspection [DOC-ASSET-029][EVT-00549][WO-00155]. Confidence is moderate because asset mapping is low confidence [DQ-0012][DQ-0053].
